title: Pay just $70 for $150 in aloSIM credit and skip roaming rates abroad
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: Pay $69.99 to get $150 in aloSIM travel-data credit, redeemable for 12 months toward country and regional packages in 200+ countries.

Coming home from vacation with a souvenir is nice. Coming home to a pile of daily international data charges? Awful. Pay $69.99 for this aloSIM offer, and you get $150 in credit to spend on mobile data packages across 200+ countries.

aloSIM uses eSIMs—digital SIM cards for compatible phones and tablets—to connect travelers to local carrier networks instead of relying on their regular carrier’s international data. Packages start at $4.50 for seven days, compared with the $10–$20 per day that carriers typically charge abroad.

The process is pretty painless. Download aloSIM, redeem your credit, choose your destination, and select a data package. Install the destination’s eSIM at home over Wi-Fi about one or two days before leaving; setup takes roughly 90 seconds and can be completed automatically on newer iPhones with a QR code or manually.

However, don’t activate the data package yet. Wait until you land because its validity period begins when it’s activated. Then turn it on and connect to the local network.

Traveling through several countries? Regional packages cover Asia, the British Isles, the Caribbean, and Eastern Europe, so multi-stop itineraries don’t necessarily require separate packages for each destination.

The eSIM profile itself doesn’t expire and can be topped up for return trips. Your $150 credit is valid for 12 months after redemption, while individual data packages expire according to their purchased validity period, and unused data does not roll over.

Before buying, confirm your phone or tablet supports eSIM. Then your next trip can involve a lot less worrying about what every megabyte is costing you.
